properties.name: pqs:context

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Used for RSA key generation in secretspec/src/generator.rs:1192, secretspec/src/spec.rs:1098, and other locations. This includes RSA private key generation which is quantum-vulnerable.

properties.value: PBKDF2 with only 1000 iterations in test code. This is below the OWASP minimum of 600,000 iterations for HMAC-SHA256 and makes password hashing vulnerable to rainbow table and brute force attacks.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-CBC mode is used in PKCS#12 certificate exports. While not directly quantum-vulnerable, CBC without authenticated encryption is vulnerable to padding oracle attacks and should be replaced with AES-GCM for better security.
